title: Miles of a Summit Choice-Benefit Bonus Credit
content:
The miles of a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program choice-benefit bonus credit are computed as follows.

**Selection fulfilled.** The selection fulfilled is the latest selection of bonus miles on the membership.

**Miles.** The bonus credit carries the selection miles: the bonus miles per selection of the tier the member holds, as the choice benefit entitlements set them, in whole miles.

| Tier held | Selection miles carried |
|---|---|
| Summit Platinum | The Summit Platinum bonus miles per selection |
| Summit Diamond | The Summit Diamond bonus miles per selection |
| Summit Chairman | The Summit Chairman bonus miles per selection |

**Points of computation.**

- The tier used is the one the member holds, not the tier that earned the selection if the two differ.
- Where several bonus-miles selections are on the membership, the latest one is the selection fulfilled.
